# Upmarkpro

> Upmarkpro designs websites, brand identities, Google visibility and Shopify stores for local businesses, professional practices and e-commerce, working remotely with clients across Italy. The site is available in Italian, English and French.

Upmarkpro is run by Adem. The six concept sites in the Work section demonstrate the approach for real industries; they are not client work and they are not the official websites of the businesses they are based on. Upmarkpro's first client project, a website redesign for Studio Dentistico Dott. Taddia in Novara, is shown separately on the same page.

## Italiano
- [Home](https://upmarkpro.com/it/): Siti web veloci, immagine coordinata e scheda Google per attività locali, studi professionali ed e-commerce. Chiamaci o scrivici su WhatsApp.
- [Servizi](https://upmarkpro.com/it/servizi/): Pacchetti per siti web da €490, più branding, visibilità su Google e negozi Shopify. Prezzi fissi, concordati prima di iniziare.
- [Progetti](https://upmarkpro.com/it/progetti/): Sei siti concept per scuole, fotovoltaico, dentisti, edilizia, barbieri ed eventi, realizzati per mostrare il nostro metodo. Passa da desktop a mobile.
- [Chi siamo](https://upmarkpro.com/it/chi-sono/): Ascolto, strategia, design e consegna: come lavoriamo con le attività locali, più le risposte alle domande più frequenti prima di iniziare.
- [Contatto](https://upmarkpro.com/it/contatto/): Mandaci il nome della tua attività per un'analisi gratuita di come ti vedono su Google e sul web, oppure raccontaci il progetto. Rispondiamo entro 24 ore.

## English
- [Home](https://upmarkpro.com/): We design More Calls Websites, brand identities and Shopify stores for local trades — so you outrank competitors, get found and win more work.
- [Services](https://upmarkpro.com/services/): Website packages from €490, plus brand identity, Google visibility and Shopify stores. Fixed prices, agreed before we start. See what's included.
- [Work](https://upmarkpro.com/work/): Six concept sites for schools, solar, dental, construction, barbers and events, built to show our approach. Switch between desktop and mobile.
- [About](https://upmarkpro.com/about/): Listen, strategy, design, delivery: how we work with local businesses, plus answers to the questions people ask before starting a website.
- [Contact](https://upmarkpro.com/contact/): Send us your business name for a free summary of how you look on Google and the web, or tell us about your project. We reply within 24 hours.

## Français
- [Accueil](https://upmarkpro.com/fr/): Sites More Calls, identités de marque et boutiques Shopify pour artisans et prestataires locaux. Soyez trouvé et décrochez plus de chantiers.
- [Services](https://upmarkpro.com/fr/services/): Offres de sites web dès 490 €, plus identité de marque, visibilité Google et boutiques Shopify. Prix fixes, validés avant de démarrer.
- [Projets](https://upmarkpro.com/fr/projets/): Six sites concept pour écoles, solaire, dentistes, bâtiment, barbiers et événements, créés pour montrer notre méthode. Passez du bureau au mobile.
- [À propos](https://upmarkpro.com/fr/a-propos/): Écoute, stratégie, design, livraison : notre façon de travailler avec les entreprises locales, et les réponses aux questions qu'on nous pose avant de commencer.
- [Contact](https://upmarkpro.com/fr/contact/): Envoyez-nous le nom de votre entreprise pour un audit gratuit de votre présence sur Google et le web, ou parlez-nous de votre projet. Réponse sous 24 h.
